brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the Border and Crossing Authority's September 2026 report documented severe deficits in travel and the flow of essential supplies into Gaza, driven by repeated closures at most land crossings. The Rafah crossing remained shut for 20 days during the month, sharply reducing the movement of humanitarian cargo.

The report indicated that aid delivery vehicles entering Gaza fell dramatically as a result of the sustained closures across multiple entry points.

title: Rafah crossing closure cuts aid trucks to Gaza to 139 in September
